statement: R-003 explicitly forces every line to start with a p- or f-initial word and draws the interior words from the unrestricted frequency table. F-003 contrasts the first word of a paragraph with mid-line words. Since every paragraph opens at a line start, that sampling rule puts the target glyphs at every measured paragraph start by construction. The attack exposes a limitation of the original contrast: it can also be satisfied by a rule that treats all line starts alike. Comparing paragraph starts with other line starts would directly test enrichment specific to paragraph starts.
